item.title: Indonesia Deploys Troops Amid Wiretapping Scandal
item.description: Indonesia's military is mobilizing troops to bolster security in Jakarta as authorities investigate the alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto. Bloomberg's Ben Otto and Faris Mokhtar discussed the developments on Insight with Haslinda Amin. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Emirates Profit Drops 66% as Iran War, High Oil Prices Hit Dubai Airline
item.description: Emirates Group’s first-half profit dropped by more than half as regional warfare and soaring oil prices weighed on the world’s largest international carrier.

item.title: France Braces for Marches and Strikes Amid Stalled Budget
item.description: France is bracing for a day of strikes and demonstrations over the cost of living, extending more than a month of protests, as parliamentary talks over next year’s budget remain deadlocked.

item.title: Orsted Completes Offshore Wind Farm That Trump Tried to Stop
item.description: Orsted A/S completed a wind farm off the northeast coast of the US that became a lightning rod for efforts by the administration of President Donald Trump to eliminate the nascent American offshore wind industry.
